title: Proof-Governed Experiential Compilation 450-Observation Controlled Matrix

hypotheses.H1: The full PGEC lane preserves or improves verified completion relative to governed no-compilation and raw lanes.
hypotheses.H2: For compatible repeated tasks, the full PGEC lane reduces provider calls without increasing false reuse.
hypotheses.H3: Ollama can originate and consume verified capabilities under the same governance contract as external providers.
hypotheses.H4: Material drift causes refusal, revalidation, or escalation rather than incorrect recurrence.
hypotheses.H5: Provider-independent capability consumption depends on evidence compatibility rather than source-provider identity.

forbidden: reclassify refusal as failure or success post hoc
exclusion_policy.rule: Every exclusion remains in the ledger with reason, timestamp, evidence reference, and replacement_status=false.

analysis_policy.paired_binary: exact McNemar where task/provider/occurrence pairs are complete
analysis_policy.paired_counts: exact sign test; Wilcoxon only when assumptions and sample size are adequate
analysis_policy.full_matrix: mixed-effects logistic regression may be exploratory, with task family and provider route as grouping factors
analysis_policy.confirmatory_boundary: Only preregistered metrics and contrasts are confirmatory

claim_boundary: The experiment tests bounded task families and declared routes. It does not establish universal coding-agent competence, universal cloud displacement, or production economics.
